senses.definition: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
senses.example: For LDS Church members, that history is taught from a young age as part of their self-identity.

senses.definition: Any of the denominations of Christianity whose teachings and/or organisation derive from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints founded by Joseph Smith, Jr. in 1830.
senses.example: And that history of persecution is newly relevant after the mass shooting and arson targeting an LDS church in Michigan last Sunday.
